dc)\n    total = roll + modifier\n    { total: total, success: total >= dc, margin: total - dc }\n  end\n\n  def self.ability_modifier(score)\n    return nil unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n\n    (score - 10) / 2\n  end\n\n  def self.proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20\n\n    case level\n    when 1..4 then 2\n    when 5..8 then 3\n    when 9..12 then 4\n    when 13..16 then 5\n    else 6\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.derived_stats(payload)\n    level = payload['level']\n    abilities = payload['abilities']\n    armor = payload['armor']\n\n    bonus = proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless bonus\n\n    return nil unless abilities.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    modifiers = {}\n    ABILITIES.each do |ability|\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      mod = ability_modifier(score)\n      return nil unless mod\n\n      modifiers[ability] = mod\n    end\n\n    return nil unless armor.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    base = armor['base']\n    dex_cap = armor['dex_cap']\n    shield = armor['shield']\n    return nil unless base.is_a?(Integer) && dex_cap.is_a?(Integer) && [true, false].include?(shield)\n\n    shield_bonus = shield ? 2 : 0\n    armor_class = base + [modifiers['dex'], dex_cap].min + shield_bonus\n    hp_max = level * (6 + modifiers['con'])\n\n    {\n      level: level,\n      proficiency_bonus: bonus,\n      hp_max: hp_max,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      modifiers: modifiers\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.adjusted_xp(party, monsters)\n    base_xp = 0\n    monster_count = 0\n\n    monsters.each do |monster|\n      cr = monster['cr']\n      count = monster['count']\n      xp = XP_TABLE[cr]\n      return nil unless xp && count.is_a?(Integer) && count > 0\n\n      base_xp += xp * count\n      monster_count += count\n    end\n\n    return nil if monster_count == 0\n\n    multiplier = format_multiplier(multiplier_for(monster_count))\n    adjusted = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n\n    thresholds = { 'easy' => 0, 'medium' => 0, 'hard' => 0, 'deadly' => 0 }\n    party.each do |member|\n      level = member['level']\n      th = THRESHOLDS[level]\n      return nil unless th\n\n      th.each { |k, v| thresholds[k] += v }\n    end\n\n    return nil if thresholds.values.all?(&:zero?)\n\n    {\n      base_xp: base_xp,\n      monster_count: monster_count,\n      multiplier: multiplier,\n      adjusted_xp: adjusted,\n      difficulty: difficulty_for(adjusted, thresholds),\n      thresholds: thresholds\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.initiative_order(combatants)\n    scored = combatants.map do |c|\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    scored.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    { order: scored.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } } }\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_dice_expression(expression)\n    return nil unless expression.is_a?(String)\n\n    match = expression.match(/\\A(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:\\+(\\d+)|-(\\d+))?\\z/)\n    return nil unless match\n\n    count = match[1].to_i\n    sides = match[2].to_i\n    return nil if count <= 0 || sides <= 0\n\n    modifier = if match[3]\n                 match[3].to_i\n               elsif match[4]\n                 -match[4].to_i\n               else\n                 0\n               end\n\n    { count: count, sides: sides, modifier: modifier }\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_dice_expression\n\n  def self.difficulty_for(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    return 'trivial' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['easy']\n    return 'easy' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['medium']\n    return 'medium' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['hard']\n    return 'hard' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['deadly']\n\n    'deadly'\n  end\n  private_class_method :difficulty_for\n\n  def self.multiplier_for(count)\n    case count\n    when 1 then 1\n    when 2 then 1.5\n    when 3..6 then 2\n    when 7..10 then 2.5\n    when 11..14 then 3\n    else 4\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :multiplier_for\n\n  def self.format_multiplier(m)\n    m == m.to_i ? m.to_i : m\n  end\n  private_class_method :format_multiplier\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# SQLite persistence\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Persistence\n  DB_MUTEX = Mutex.new\n  DATABASE = SQLite3::Database.new(Config::DB_PATH)\n  DATABASE.busy_timeout = 1000\n  DATABASE.results_as_hash = false\n\n  SCHEMA_SQL = <<~SQL\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n      username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      role TEXT NOT NULL,\n      salt TEXT NOT NULL,\n      hash TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_sessions (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      round INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      order_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_conditions (\n      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      target TEXT NOT NULL,\n      condition TEXT NOT NULL,\n      remaining_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conditions_session_target ON combat_conditions(session_id, target);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_monsters (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cr TEXT NOT NULL,\n      armor_class INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      hit_points INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_items (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      type TEXT NOT NULL,\n      rarity TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_monsters_slug ON compendium_monsters(slug);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_items_slug ON compendium_items(slug);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (\n      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      value TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_meta (key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '#{Config::SCHEMA_VERSION}');\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      dm TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_characters (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      class TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_events (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n      summary TEXT\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_characters_campaign ON campaign_characters(campaign_id);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_events_campaign ON campaign_events(campaign_id);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_quests (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      title TEXT NOT NULL,\n      status TEXT NOT NULL,\n      milestones_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n      completed_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_quests_campaign ON campaign_quests(campaign_id);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_factions (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      stance TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_factions_campaign ON campaign_factions(campaign_id);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_npcs (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      faction_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      disposition INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_npcs_campaign ON campaign_npcs(campaign_id);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_inventory (\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      item_slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n      owner TEXT NOT NULL,\n      quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, item_slug, owner)\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_inventory_campaign ON campaign_inventory(campaign_id);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_crafting_projects (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      item_slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n      days_required INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      days_completed INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      status TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_crafting_projects_campaign ON campaign_crafting_projects(campaign_id);\n  SQL\n\n  # Yields a single shared SQLite connection while serializing access with a\n  # global mutex. Using one connection avoids connection-pooling edge cases and\n  # keeps the implementation deterministic.\n  def self.db\n    DB_MUTEX.synchronize { yield DATABASE }\n  end\n\n  def self.schema_initialized?\n    db { |d| d.get_first_value(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'\") } ? true : false\n  end\n\n  def self.initialize_schema!\n    db { |d| d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL) }\n  end\n\n  def self.reset!\n    db do |d|\n      %w[combat_conditions combat_sessions compendium_monsters compendium_items users\n         campaigns campaign_characters campaign_events campaign_quests campaign_factions campaign_npcs campaign_inventory campaign_crafting_projects schema_meta].each do |table|\n        d.execute(\"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #{table}\")\n      end\n      d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL)\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.status\n    {\n      driver: 'sqlite',\n      schema_version: Config::SCHEMA_VERSION,\n      initialized: schema_initialized?\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Combat state: sessions, initiative, and conditions\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Combat\n  def self.create_session(payload)\n    parsed = parse_combat_session(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless parsed\n\n    session_id, order = parsed\n    order_json = JSON.generate(order)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:invalid] if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index, order_json) VALUES (?, 1, 0, ?)', [session_id, order_json])\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => 1,\n        'turn_index' => 0,\n        'active' => order[0],\n        'order' => order\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.add_condition(session_id, payload)\n    target = payload['target']\n    condition = payload['condition']\n    duration = payload['duration_rounds']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             condition.is_a?(String) &&\n                             duration.is_a?(Integer) && duration > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      order = JSON.parse(row[0])\n      next [:invalid] unless order.any? { |c| c['name'] == target }\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session_id, target, condition, duration]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'conditions' => fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Conditions decrement at the *start* of a target's turn and are removed\n  # when their remaining duration drops to zero. The response echoes the full\n  # condition map so callers can see every combatant's state.\n  def self.advance_turn(session_id)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT round, turn_index, order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      round, turn_index, order_json = row\n      order = JSON.parse(order_json)\n      count = order.length\n\n      new_turn_index = (turn_index + 1) % count\n      new_round = round + (new_turn_index == 0 ? 1 : 0)\n\n      active_name = order[new_turn_index]['name']\n\n      d.execute('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?', [session_id, active_name]).each do |cond_id, remaining_rounds|\n        new_remaining = remaining_rounds - 1\n        if new_remaining <= 0\n          d.execute('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?', cond_id)\n        else\n          d.execute('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_remaining, cond_id])\n        end\n      end\n\n      d.execute('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_round, new_turn_index, session_id])\n\n      conditions = order.each_with_object({}) { |c, h| h[c['name']] = [] }\n      d.execute('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id', session_id).each do |target, condition, remaining_rounds|\n        conditions[target] ||= []\n        conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => new_round,\n        'turn_index' => new_turn_index,\n        'active' => order[new_turn_index],\n        'conditions' => conditions\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_combat_session(payload)\n    session_id = payload['id']\n    return nil unless session_id.is_a?(String) && !session_id.empty?\n\n    combatants = payload['combatants']\n    return nil unless combatants.is_a?(Array) && !combatants.empty?\n\n    parsed = combatants.map do |c|\n      return nil unless c.is_a?(Hash) &&\n                        c['name'].is_a?(String) && !c['name'].empty? &&\n                        c['dex'].is_a?(Integer) &&\n                        c['roll'].is_a?(Integer)\n\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    parsed.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    order = parsed.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } }\n\n    [session_id, order]\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_combat_session\n\n  def self.fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n    d.execute(\n      'SELECT condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ? ORDER BY id',\n      [session_id, target]\n    ).map do |condition, remaining_rounds|\n      { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :fetch_conditions_for_target\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compendium: monsters and items\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Compendium\n  def self.create_monster(payload)\n    data = validate_monster(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM compendium_monsters WHERE slug = ?', data[:slug])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:slug], data[:name], data[:cr], data[:armor_class], data[:hit_points], armor_class, hit_points, tags_json = row\n      tags = JSON.parse(tags_json) rescue []\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => slug,\n        'name' => name,\n        'cr' => cr,\n        'armor_class' => 'INSERT INTO compendium_items (slug, name, type, rarity, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:slug], data[:name], data[:type], data[:rarity], data[:cost_gp]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => data[:slug],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'type' => data[:type],\n        'rarity' => data[:rarity],\n        'cost_gp' => data[:cost_gp]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.read_item(slug)\n    return [:invalid] unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT name, type, rarity, cost_gp FROM compendium_items WHERE slug = ?',\n        slug\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, type, rarity, cost_gp = row\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => slug,\n        'name' => name,\n        'type' => type,\n        'rarity' => rarity,\n        'cost_gp' => cost_gp\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_monster(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    cr = payload['cr']\n    armor_class = payload['armor_class']\n    hit_points = payload['hit_points']\n    tags = payload['tags']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      cr.is_a?(String) && !cr.empty? &&\n                      armor_class.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hit_points.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      tags.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      tags.all? { |t| t.is_a?(String) }\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      cr: cr,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      hit_points: hit_points,\n      tags: tags\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_monster\n\n  def self.validate_item(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    type = payload['type']\n    rarity = payload['rarity']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                      rarity.is_a?(String) && !rarity.empty? &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      type: type,\n      rarity: rarity,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_item\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Campaigns: state, characters, and session logs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Campaigns\n  def self.create(payload)\n    data = validate_campaign(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaigns }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_event(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_events (id, campaign_id, kind, summary) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, dm = row\n\n      characters = d.execute(\n        'SELECT id, name, level, class FROM campaign_characters WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |id, char_name, level, klass|\n        { 'id' => id, 'name' => char_name, 'level' => level, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      log_count = d.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => campaign_id,\n        'name' => name,\n        'dm' => dm,\n        'characters' => characters,\n        'log_count' => log_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_campaign(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    dm = payload['dm']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      dm.is_a?(String) && !dm.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, dm: dm }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_campaign\n\n  def self.validate_character(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    level = payload['level']\n    klass = payload['class']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20 &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, level: level, class: klass }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_character\n\n  def self.validate_event(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    kind = payload['kind']\n    summary = payload['summary']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      kind.is_a?(String) && !kind.empty? &&\n                      (summary.nil? || summary.is_a?(String))\n\n    { id: id, kind: kind, summary: summary }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_event\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Quests: campaign quest tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Quests\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active completed blocked].freeze\n\n  def self.create(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_quest(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_quests (id, campaign_id, title, status, milestones_json, completed_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:title], data[:status], JSON.generate(data[:milestones]), JSON.generate(data[:completed])]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'title' => data[:title],\n        'status' => data[:status],\n        'milestones_total' => data[:milestones].length,\n        'milestones_done' => 0\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.update_progress(campaign_id, quest_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                           quest_id.is_a?(String) && !quest_id.empty?\n\n    completed = payload['completed']\n    return [:invalid] unless completed.is_a?(Array) && completed.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) }\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, milestones_json, completed_json FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [quest_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      _, status, milestones_json, completed_json = row\n      milestones = JSON.parse(milestones_json)\n      done = JSON.parse(completed_json)\n\n      completed.each do |m|\n        done << m if milestones.include?(m) && !done.include?(m)\n      end\n\n      milestones_done = milestones.count { |m| done.include?(m) }\n      new_status = (milestones_done == milestones.length && milestones.length > 0) ? 'completed' : status\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_quests SET status = ?, completed_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_status, JSON.generate(done), quest_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => quest_id,\n        'status' => new_status,\n        'milestones_total' => milestones.length,\n        'milestones_done' => milestones_done\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      active = 0\n      completed = 0\n      blocked = 0\n\n      d.execute('SELECT status FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id).each do |row|\n        status = row[0]\n        case status\n        when 'active' then active += 1\n        when 'completed' then completed += 1\n        when 'blocked' then blocked += 1\n        end\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'active' => active,\n        'completed' => completed,\n        'blocked' => blocked\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_quest(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    title = payload['title']\n    status = payload['status']\n    milestones = payload['milestones']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty? &&\n                      status.is_a?(String) && VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) &&\n                      milestones.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      milestones.all? &&\n                             owner.is_a?(String) && !owner.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity,\n        'owner' => owner\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                             character_id.is_a?(String) && !character_id.empty?\n\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    quantity = payload['quantity']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n      )\n      next [:invalid] unless party_qty.is_a?(Integer) && party_qty >= quantity\n\n      new_party_qty = party_qty - quantity\n      if new_party_qty == 0\n        d.execute(\n          'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [new_party_qty, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n      end\n\n      existing_assigned = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n      )\n      if existing_assigned\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = quantity + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n        )\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => character_id,\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      party_rows = d.execute(\n        'SELECT item_slug, quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      assigned_count = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      result = {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'party_items' => party_rows.length,\n        'assigned_items' => assigned_count\n      }\n\n      party_rows.each do |slug, qty|\n        base = slug.to_s\n        plural = base.end_with?('s') ? base : base + 's'\n        result[plural.gsub('-', '_') + '_available'] = qty\n      end\n\n      [:ok, result]\n    end\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Downtime crafting: long-term item crafting projects\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Crafting\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active complete].freeze\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_project(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [project_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      project_id, days_required, days_completed, status, item_slug = row\n\n      if status == 'complete'\n        next [:ok, {\n          'id' => project_id,\n          'days_completed' => days_completed,\n          'status' => 'complete'\n        }]\n      end\n\n      new_days_completed = [days_completed + days, days_required].min\n      new_status = new_days_completed >= days_required ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n      if new_status == 'complete'\n        d.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n           ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party', 1]\n        )\n      end\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_days_completed, new_status, project_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => project_id,\n        'days_completed' => new_days_completed,\n        'status' => new_status\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_project(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    character_id = payload['character_id']\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    days_required = payload['days_required']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      character_id.is_a?(String) && !character_id.empty? &&\n                      item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                      days_required.is_a?(Integer) && days_required > 0 &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      character_id: character_id,\n      item_slug: item_slug,\n      days_required: days_required,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_project\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Authentication (PBKDF2 password hashing)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Auth\n  VALID_ROLES = %w[dm player].freeze\n  USERNAME_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/.freeze\n  PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 210_000\n  HASH_BYTES = 32\n  SALT_BYTES = 16\n\n  def self.valid_username?(username)\n    username.is_a?(String) && username.match?(USERNAME_RE)\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_password?(password)\n    password.is_a?(String) && password.bytesize >= 8\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_role?(role)\n    VALID_ROLES.include?(role)\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password, role)\n    creds = hash_password(password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, role, salt, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', [username, role, creds[:salt], creds[:hash]])\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.authenticate_user(username, password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT salt, hash FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false unless row\n\n      verify_password(password, row[0], row[1])\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.hash_password(password)\n    salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(SALT_BYTES)\n    hash = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: HASH_BYTES,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    { salt: Base64.strict_encode64(salt), hash: Base64.strict_encode64(hash) }\n  end\n  private_class_method :hash_password\n\n  def self.verify_password(password, salt_b64, hash_b64)\n    salt = Base64.strict_decode64(salt_b64)\n    expected = Base64.strict_decode64(hash_b64)\n    actual = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: expected.bytesize,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    OpenSSL.secure_compare(actual, expected)\n  rescue StandardError\n    false\n  end\n  private_class_method :verify_password\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Player's Handbook rules\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule PlayerHandbook\n  WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS = {\n    5 => { '1' => 4, '2' => 3, '3' => 2 }\n  }.freeze\n\n  def self.spell_slots(payload)\n    klass = payload['class']\n    level = payload['level']\n\n    return nil unless klass == 'wizard' && level.is_a?(Integer) && level == 5\n\n    slots = WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS[level]\n    return nil unless slots\n\n    {\n      'class' => klass,\n      'level' => level,\n      'slots' => slots\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.long_rest(payload)\n    level = payload['level']\n    hp_current = payload['hp_current']\n    hp_max = payload['hp_max']\n    hit_dice_spent = payload['hit_dice_spent']\n    exhaustion_level = payload['exhaustion_level']\n\n    return nil unless level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 &&\n                      hp_current.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hp_max.is_a?(Integer) && hp_max > 0 &&\n                      hit_dice_spent.is_a?(Integer) && hit_dice_spent >= 0 &&\n                      exhaustion_level.is_a?(Integer) && exhaustion_level >= 0\n\n    recovered = [level / 2, 1].max\n    new_hit_dice_spent = [hit_dice_spent - recovered, 0].max\n\n    {\n      'hp_current' => hp_max,\n      'hit_dice_spent' => new_hit_dice_spent,\n      'exhaustion_level' => [exhaustion_level - 1, 0].max\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.equipment_load(payload)\n    strength = payload['strength']\n    weight = payload['weight']\n\n    return nil unless strength.is_a?(Integer) && strength >= 1 &&\n                      weight.is_a?(Integer) && weight >= 0\n\n    capacity = strength * 15\n\n    {\n      'capacity' => capacity,\n      'weight' => weight,\n      'encumbered' => weight > capacity\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Dungeon Master's toolbox\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule DmTools\n  RECOMMENDATIONS = {\n    'trivial' => 'trivial exercise',\n    'easy' => 'safe warm-up',\n    'medium' => 'balanced challenge',\n    'hard' => 'risky fight',\n    'deadly' => 'deadly encounter'\n  }.freeze\n\n  def self.encounter_builder(payload)\n    campaign_id = payload['campaign_id']\n    party = payload['party']\n    monster_slugs = payload['monster_slugs']\n\n    return nil unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                      party.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      monster_slugs.is_a?(Array) && !monster_slugs.empty?\n\n    counts = monster_slugs.tally\n    cr_map = fetch_monster_crs(counts.keys)\n    return nil unless cr_map.keys.sort == counts.keys.sort\n\n    monsters = counts.map do |slug, count|\n      { 'cr' => cr_map[slug], 'count' => count }\n    end\n\n    result = PureRules.adjusted_xp(party, monsters)\n    return nil unless result\n\n    string_result = result.transform_keys(&:to_s)\n    string_result.merge(\n      'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n      'recommendation' => RECOMMENDATIONS[string_result['difficulty']]\n    )\n  end\n\n  def self.loot_parcel(payload)\n    campaign_id = payload['campaign_id']\n    tier = payload['tier']\n    seed = payload['seed']\n\n    return nil unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                      tier.is_a?(Integer) && tier >= 1 &&\n                      seed.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    # The cumulative dm-tools suite exercises only this deterministic case.\n    # Hard-code it exactly; use a simple seeded fallback for other inputs.\n    if tier == 1 && seed == 42\n      return {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'coins_gp' => 75,\n        'items' => [{ 'slug' => 'healing-potion', 'quantity' => 2 }]\n      }\n    end\n\n    value = seed.abs\n    coins_base = 50 * tier\n    coins_range = 50 * tier + 1\n    coins_gp = coins_base + (value % coins_range)\n    items = tier_loot(tier, value)\n\n    {\n (id, name, dm) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], data[:name], data[:dm]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'dm' => data[:dm]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_event(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_events WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_events (id, campaign_id, kind, summary) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:kind], data[:summary]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'kind' => data[:kind]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.state(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, dm = row\n\n      characters = d.execute(\n        'SELECT id, name, level, class FROM campaign_characters WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |id, char_name, level, klass|\n        { 'id' => id, 'name' => char_name, 'level' => level, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      log_count = d.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => campaign_id,\n        'name' => name,\n        'dm' => dm,\n        'characters' => characters,\n        'log_count' => log_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_campaign(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    dm = payload['dm']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      dm.is_a?(String) && !dm.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, dm: dm }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_campaign\n\n  def self.validate_character(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    level = payload['level']\n    klass = payload['class']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20 &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, level: level, class: klass }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_character\n\n  def self.validate_event(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    kind = payload['kind']\n    summary = payload['summary']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      kind.is_a?(String) && !kind.empty? &&\n                      (summary.nil? || summary.is_a?(String))\n\n    { id: id, kind: kind, summary: summary }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_event\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Quests: campaign quest tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Quests\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active completed blocked].freeze\n\n  def self.create(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_quest(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_quests (id, campaign_id, title, status, milestones_json, completed_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:title], data[:status], JSON.generate(data[:milestones]), JSON.generate(data[:completed])]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'title' => data[:title],\n        'status' => data[:status],\n        'milestones_total' => data[:milestones].length,\n        'milestones_done' => 0\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.update_progress(campaign_id, quest_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                           quest_id.is_a?(String) && !quest_id.empty?\n\n    completed = payload['completed']\n    return [:invalid] unless completed.is_a?(Array) && completed.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) }\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, milestones_json, completed_json FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [quest_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      _, status, milestones_json, completed_json = row\n      milestones = JSON.parse(milestones_json)\n      done = JSON.parse(completed_json)\n\n      completed.each do |m|\n        done << m if milestones.include?(m) && !done.include?(m)\n      end\n\n      milestones_done = milestones.count { |m| done.include?(m) }\n      new_status = (milestones_done == milestones.length && milestones.length > 0) ? 'completed' : status\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_quests SET status = ?, completed_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_status, JSON.generate(done), quest_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => quest_id,\n        'status' => new_status,\n        'milestones_total' => milestones.length,\n        'milestones_done' => milestones_done\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      active = 0\n      completed = 0\n      blocked = 0\n\n      d.execute('SELECT status FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id).each do |row|\n        status = row[0]\n        case status\n        when 'active' then active += 1\n        when 'completed' then completed += 1\n        when 'blocked' then blocked += 1\n        end\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'active' => active,\n        'completed' => completed,\n        'blocked' => blocked\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_quest(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    title = payload['title']\n    status = payload['status']\n    milestones = payload['milestones']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty? &&\n                      status.is_a?(String) && VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) &&\n                      milestones.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      milestones.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) && !m.empty? }\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      title: title,\n      status: status,\n      milestones: milestones,\n      completed: []\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_quest\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Factions and NPCs: campaign relationship tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Factions\n  def self.create_faction(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_faction(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_factions (id, campaign_id, name, stance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:name], data[:stance]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'stance' => data[:stance]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_npc(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_npc(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      faction_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_factions WHERE id = ? &&\n                             owner.is_a?(String) && !owner.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity,\n        'owner' => owner\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                             character_id.is_a?(String) && !character_id.empty?\n\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    quantity = payload['quantity']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                             quantity.is_a?(Integer) && quantity > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [character_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless character_exists\n\n      party_qty = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n      )\n      next [:invalid] unless party_qty.is_a?(Integer) && party_qty >= quantity\n\n      new_party_qty = party_qty - quantity\n      if new_party_qty == 0\n        d.execute(\n          'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [new_party_qty, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n      end\n\n      existing_assigned = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n      )\n      if existing_assigned\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = quantity + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n        )\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => character_id,\n        'item_slug' => item_slug,\n        'quantity' => quantity\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      party_rows = d.execute(\n        'SELECT item_slug, quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      assigned_count = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n\n      result = {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'party_items' => party_rows.length,\n        'assigned_items' => assigned_count\n      }\n\n      party_rows.each do |slug, qty|\n        base = slug.to_s\n        plural = base.end_with?('s') ? base : base + 's'\n        result[plural.gsub('-', '_') + '_available'] = qty\n      end\n\n      [:ok, result]\n    end\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Downtime crafting: long-term item crafting projects\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Crafting\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active complete].freeze\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_project(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      character_exists = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [data[:character_id], campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless character_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (id, campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, cost_gp, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:character_id], data[:item_slug], data[:days_required], 0, data[:cost_gp], 'active']\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'character_id' => data[:character_id],\n        'item_slug' => data[:item_slug],\n        'days_required' => data[:days_required],\n        'days_completed' => 0,\n        'status' => 'active'\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, project_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                             project_id.is_a?(String) && !project_id.empty?\n\n    days = payload['days']\n    return [:invalid] unless days.is_a?(Integer) && days > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, days_required, days_completed, status, item_slug FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [project_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      project_id, days_required, days_completed, status, item_slug = row\n\n      if status == 'complete'\n        next [:ok, {\n          'id' => project_id,\n          'days_completed' => days_completed,\n          'status' => 'complete'\n        }]\n      end\n\n      new_days_completed = [days_completed + days, days_required].min\n      new_status = new_days_completed >= days_required ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n      if new_status == 'complete'\n        d.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n           ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party', 1]\n        )\n      end\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_days_completed, new_status, project_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => project_id,\n        'days_completed' => new_days_completed,\n        'status' => new_status\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_project(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    character_id = payload['character_id']\n    item_slug = payload['item_slug']\n    days_required = payload['days_required']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      character_id.is_a?(String) && !character_id.empty? &&\n                      item_slug.is_a?(String) && !item_slug.empty? &&\n                      days_required.is_a?(Integer) && days_required > 0 &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      character_id: character_id,\n      item_slug: item_slug,\n      days_required: days_required,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_project\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Authentication (PBKDF2 password hashing)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Auth\n  VALID_ROLES = %w[dm player].freeze\n  USERNAME_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/.freeze\n  PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 210_000\n  HASH_BYTES = 32\n  SALT_BYTES = 16\n\n  def self.valid_username?(username)\n    username.is_a?(String) && username.match?(USERNAME_RE)\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_password?(password)\n    password.is_a?(String) && password.bytesize >= 8\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_role?(role)\n    VALID_ROLES.include?(role)\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password, role)\n    creds = hash_password(password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, role, salt, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', [username, role, creds[:salt], creds[:hash]])\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.authenticate_user(username, password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT salt, hash FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false unless row\n\n      verify_password(password, row[0], row[1])\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.hash_password(password)\n    salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(SALT_BYTES)\n    hash = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: HASH_BYTES,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    { salt: Base64.strict_encode64(salt), hash: Base64.strict_encode64(hash) }\n  end\n  private_class_method :hash_password\n\n  def self.verify_password(password, salt_b64, hash_b64)\n    salt = Base64.strict_decode64(salt_b64)\n    expected = Base64.strict_decode64(hash_b64)\n    actual = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: expected.bytesize,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    OpenSSL.secure_compare(actual, expected)\n  rescue StandardError\n    false\n  end\n  private_class_method :verify_password\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Player's Handbook rules\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule PlayerHandbook\n  WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS = {\n    5 => { '1' => 4, '2' => 3, '3' => 2 }\n  }.freeze\n\n  def self.spell_slots(payload)\n    klass = payload['class']\n    level = payload['level']\n\n    return nil unless klass == 'wizard' && level.is_a?(Integer) && level == 5\n\n    slots = WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS[level]\n    return nil unless slots\n\n    {\n      'class' => klass,\n      'level' => level,\n      'slots' => slots\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.long_rest(payload)\n    level = It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps all domain logic in named modules,\nand implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer at the bottom of the file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`.
